text: Extract Reheating Started, Rolling Completed and Crop Shear Passed for each as-rolled mother material.
For each mother material, show actual furnace entry, rolling completion and crop-shear passage.
Extract Inspection Failed, Heat Treatment Completed and Inspection Passed for each mother material, including all its descendant Plate materials.
Trace every failed inspection, thermal treatment and passing inspection of pieces originating from each mother material.
Extract the complete recorded manufacturing lifecycle for each as-rolled mother material, including its descendant Plate materials.
Build a mother-material log covering all recorded actual production steps and downstream operations on its cut pieces.
Extract Cutting Instruction Released, Split Cutting Completed and Dimensional Inspection Completed for each mother material and its cut pieces.
Extract continuous-casting start and completion for each slab.
Extract an event log for each slab. Include all recorded manufacturing events of the mother material and cut pieces derived from this slab; no upstream casting events are inferred.
Extract an event log for each rolling plan. Include the actual release of the rolling instruction linked to this plan; planned reheating times are not execution events.
Extract an event log for each rolling instruction. Include the actual release event for this rolling instruction.
Extract an event log for each mother material. Include all recorded mother-material events and its descendant-piece events, each occurrence once.
Extract an event log for each furnace tracking record. Include the recorded yard-instruction receipt for this tracking record; lot-level charging events remain outside the material-event set.
Extract an event log for each cutting instruction. Include the actual release event for this cutting/finishing instruction.
Extract an event log for each cut plate piece. Include only operations recorded on this piece and its dimensional inspection. Upstream mother events are not copied to each piece.
Extract an event log for each material operation record. Include the operation-completion event represented by this transaction ID, preserving its process-code meaning.
